newsitem.title: UK: Asda shares gain after market share data.
newsitem.headline: Asda shares gain after market share data.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Asda Group Plc rose in active trade on Thursday after figures from market research group AGB showed the supermarket operator continuing to gain market share, traders and analysts said.
The stock was up 3p at 119-1/2 by 1109 GMT in heavy trading of 11.6 million shares, making it the most active stock in the London market.

Asda's market share in value terms rose to a record 13.4 percent in November from 13.2 percent a month before. "Asda is doing really well and its year-on-year performance is looking outstanding," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
Analysts said AGB data also showed Safeway Plc increasing market share, to 10.9 percent in November from 10.4 percent a month earlier.

Safeway was up 9p at a record 389p in volume of 2.2 million shares, also buoyed by the company's strong results last week and a banking deal with Abbey National Plc announced earlier today, analysts said.
Analysts said Asda's AGB figures had lifted the stock ahead of the company's results on December 19.
Some analysts were sceptical about the value of the AGB figures but others said they were a good guide to underlying trends in the sector.
"For Asda they have proved a good trend guide," said one.
